meta.title: Covelet · Your everyday sites, one new tab
meta.description: A new tab for Chrome and Edge. Organize sites, search the web and keep notes. No Covelet account needed. Data is encrypted in this browser by default, with optional bring-your-own-storage sync (Beta).
hero.h1: Your everyday sites. One new tab.
hero.tagline: Keep sites in order, search the web and jot down a thought.
hero.lead: Covelet is a new-tab extension for Chrome and Edge. No Covelet account needed.
features.organize_body: Add sites, group them in folders and drag them into place.
features.search_body: Search the web, or find sites and notes stored in this browser.
features.notes_body: Write a note or save a link to read later.
features.appearance_body: Choose a background, icon size and layout that work for you.
privacy.title: Saved in your browser by default
privacy.local_body: Sites, notes and settings are saved in this browser. They are not uploaded to Covelet.
privacy.network_body: Sync, daily wallpapers, web searches and manual site lookups use the internet. Privacy checkup explains what each permission is for.
privacy.site_note: This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics for visit statistics.
sync.title: Sync with your storage (Beta)
sync.intro: Connect your own storage to sync sites, notes and settings across devices. Content is encrypted and sent directly to your storage, without passing through a Covelet server.
sync.conflict_body: If versions conflict, compare the local and remote versions, then choose which one to keep.
sync.beta_note: R2, OSS, GitHub and GitLab are also available as Beta options.
backup.title: Keep a separate backup.
backup.intro: Export your data to a file outside the browser.
backup.export_body: Back up sites, folders, notes and settings. Backup files are not encrypted and include hidden content. Keep them somewhere safe.
backup.bookmarks_body: Import a bookmark HTML file exported by your browser. Preview it before importing.
close.title: Start with the sites you use.

sync.storage_body: Supports WebDAV services such as Nutstore and Nextcloud.
